notes.title: Pick Me！Find Me！
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

First off, a heartfelt thanks to all of you—whether you're young or just young at heart—for your incredible love and support for Sophia the Traveler. We are honestly so excited to have you join us on this warm, relaxing journey through Venice. Sophia’s been walking the charming streets with you, soaking up the sunshine in the squares, and drifting along the peaceful canals, all while uncovering hidden gems in Venice’s timeless buildings and art. Your energy has made the world of Sophia the Traveler even more special and alive.

We are also thrilled to share that Sophia the Traveler is eligible for two 2024 Steam Awards: the “𝐒𝐢𝐭 𝐁𝐚𝐜𝐤 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐑𝐞𝐥𝐚𝐱 𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝” and “𝐎𝐮𝐭𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐕𝐢𝐬𝐮𝐚𝐥 𝐒𝐭𝐲𝐥𝐞 𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝”! If the beauty and serenity of the game or the warmth of its story has touched you, we’d be truly honored if you considered nominating us for these categories. Your support has always meant so much to us, and your nomination would be the ultimate encouragement!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318709/3d6f44ed1edc757a2961266e3507519092895209.jpg[/img]

And here is something special for all the new players: during the Steam Autumn Sale, Sophia the Traveler is available at a limited-time discount! If you’ve been waiting for the perfect moment to explore Venice, now’s your chance. Whether you’re diving into its history and culture or simply looking for a relaxing, heartwarming adventure, Sophia the Traveler promises a one-of-a-kind experience.

Don’t wait—take advantage of the Autumn Sale, pick up Sophia the Traveler, and let the calm waters of Venice carry you on a unique and unforgettable journey!

Warm wishes,
The Sophia the Traveler Team

notes.title: Sophia the Traveler Out Now! 10% Launch Discount!
Journey to Venice with Sophia the Traveler on April 11!
notes.notes:
As spring blooms and the weather takes a turn for the sunny, our little Sophia is finally ready to set sail to the romantic Venice! Save the date, and join Sophia the Traveler on April 11, 2024, with a 10% launch discount for the first week! 

Driven by a deep affection for the City of Water, we decided to develop this hand-painted hidden object game set in Venice. Every step of the way is brimming with endeavor, passion, and hope. Our aim is not only to offer an exciting video game adventure but also to rebuild a vivid tapestry of virtual Venice itself. Join Sophia the Traveler as she navigates through winding water alleyways, uncovering hidden secrets and quirky Easter eggs amidst the iconic buildings and vibrant crowds. 

Thank you for your encouragement and support all along. And see you soon in this magical world of hand-drawn Venice!

notes.title: Sophia the Traveler Launching in 2024!
notes.notes:
Hey guys, we are thrilled to announce that Sophia the Traveler is set to launch in 2024! In this unique picture-book-style puzzler, you will embark on a wholesome journey to the enchanting hand-painted Venice. Explore the history, culture, and numerous hidden Easter Eggs as you roam the City of Water with Sophia the Traveler!

Sophia the Traveler was created out of our love for Venice. Over three years, we meticulously researched every street and corner of Venice using Google Maps and loads of travel books, striving to authentically recreate the appearance of Venice. While we have yet to fulfill our dream of actually visiting Venice, we're excited to bring the romance of the city to you through this game.

Additionally, Sophia the Traveler will be part of the in-person celebration for Day of the Devs: The Game Awards Edition in Los Angeles on December 8th (2 pm – 8 pm PT), where you could get hands-on with the latest demo. This is Sophia's second "trip" following her debut at the gamescom 2023 in Cologne, and we're really honored to share this news.

A big thank you for your support to Sophia the Traveler. Can't wait to embark on this delightful journey with you!
